diagnoses.label: amount_writeback_empty_string_instead_of_null_for_078
diagnoses.general_pattern: When extraction fails for a declared-null field, the writeback stores an empty string sentinel instead of a true Python None, violating the task's null contract and failing exact-match grading on that cell.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Routing a missing total through a formatted string path (e.g. str(value) or f"{value}") or assigning "" to the openpyxl cell when extraction returned no value, so the stored cell is empty-string rather than None.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: In the predictions table the row for 078.jpg shows total_amount="" while every other row has a non-empty two-decimal string; the feedback marks 078 amount_correct=false even though the agent clearly treated this receipt as a failed-amount case. Other failed-amount rows (074, 077) are populated with wrong non-empty values, so the empty cell on 078 is specifically the null-writeback path.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: Not enforcing the null-vs-empty-string contract: failed extractions must be returned as Python None and assigned directly to the openpyxl cell, and the saved workbook must be reloaded and verified with cell.value is None (not == "") before finishing.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Return None from the extractor on failure, assign None (never "", "None", or str(None)) to the cell, and run a delivery-contract self-check that reloads the xlsx with data_only=True and asserts cell.value is None for intended-null cells.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies only to receipt-extraction / data-only xlsx tasks whose contract explicitly distinguishes null from empty string for a failed field.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Tasks whose output contract uses "" or a specific placeholder string as the missing-value sentinel, financial-model xlsx outputs with formulas, or non-xlsx deliveries.
diagnoses.target_section: Preserving null vs empty string on writeback / Delivery contract verification for data-only xlsx outputs

diagnoses.label: total_tier_tabular_header_misbinding_on_074
diagnoses.general_pattern: Within a priority tier, the selector accepts a line whose keyword co-occurs with other column-header or qualifier tokens (e.g. 'Amt Rounded' adjacent to OCR-noisy digits) and takes it as the final total, even though a cleaner same-tier candidate on an earlier line is corroborated by Subtotal/Payment at the identical value.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Taking the last keyword-matching line in the tier as the final answer without considering corroboration from Subtotal/Payment lines on the same receipt, so a severely OCR-corrupted 'Total Amt Rounded' line wins over cleanly parsed 'Total incl. of GST' / 'Payment' / 'Subtotal' candidates that all agree on another value.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: 074.jpg prediction total_amount="702.00" marked amount_correct=false; the image clearly shows Subtotal 102.00, Total Excl. of GST 96.23, Total Incl. of GST 102.00, Total Amt Rounded 102.00, Payment 102.00. Multiple non-tier anchors (Subtotal, Payment, Total Incl.) corroborate 102.00 and the only outlier is the Rounded line, which OCRs as 702 due to a leading-1 → 7 confusable.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: Not reconciling candidates with the corroborated-support rule: a single candidate that disagrees with multiple parsed Subtotal/Payment/Total-Incl. anchors on the same receipt should lose to the corroborated value within the same tier, instead of being blindly promoted by last-in-tier ordering.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Rank in-tier candidates by (tier_rank, corroborated_support, cross_variant_support, position); when a same-tier candidate is contradicted by Subtotal and Payment lines that agree with another in-tier candidate at the two-decimal invariant, prefer the corroborated value.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies only to receipt totals under the task-declared keyword-priority tiers with both Subtotal/Payment anchors parseable on the same receipt; does not change tier ordering itself.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Overriding a strictly higher-priority tier using lower-tier anchors, voting across unrelated numeric fields (prices, GST), or applying consensus when Subtotal/Payment are not reliably present.

diagnoses.label: total_pretax_subtotal_selected_as_total_on_077
diagnoses.general_pattern: A 'Total (Excluding GST)' / pre-tax subtotal line is accepted as the final total because the current exclusion list only screens explicit SUBTOTAL/SUB TOTAL tokens and misses the Excluding/Excl. qualifier that marks a pre-tax amount.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Treating any line containing TOTAL as a tier-4 total candidate without filtering lines qualified by 'Excluding GST', 'Excl. of GST', 'Excl GST', so a pre-tax subtotal variant beats the real 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' line.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: The 077.jpg receipt shows 'Total (Excluding GST): 21.30' and 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' plus 'TOTAL: 23.25'. The predicted total_amount="23.26" is marked amount_correct=false, indicating the inclusive line (or a close variant) was taken while a different pre-tax or rounded sibling is the oracle answer; the near-identical neighboring 'Total (Excluding GST): 21.30' line demonstrates the exclusion gap that the current pipeline must disambiguate before relying on last-in-tier.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: Did not add an Excluding/Excl. qualifier to the exclusion-aware filter inside the tier walk, and did not reconcile tier-4 candidates (Total Excluding, Total Inclusive, TOTAL rounded) by cross-anchor corroboration before selecting.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Extend the pre-cutoff exclusion-aware filter with Excluding/Excl.-qualifier screening on the same canonicalized line, then run the keyword-priority tier walk; when multiple tier-4 totals coexist, prefer the one corroborated by payment/change arithmetic.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies only to total extraction on receipts where the task prompt supplies a keyword/exclusion contract; the Excluding/Excl. filter is scoped to lines where it co-occurs with TOTAL and does not alter other tiers.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Excluding/Excl. appearing in free text or product names unrelated to a total line, and tasks whose contract explicitly wants the pre-tax amount.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation (exclusion keyword set)

diagnoses.label: date_label_binding_misses_print_timestamp_on_034
diagnoses.general_pattern: When a receipt carries both a transaction DATE and a later PRINT ON / Closed timestamp, the extractor binds to a date-shaped token without checking whether the owning line is a print/close label rather than the transaction date label.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: Taking the first (or last) date-shaped token in the OCR output without filtering lines whose label is PRN ON, PRINT, CLOSED, CLOSING, FRN, LOYALTY, PROMO, so a later print timestamp overrides the earlier transaction DATE.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: 034.jpg shows 'Date : 30/03/2018 # 8:13 PM' and 'PRN ON : 30/03/2018 11:18 PM' plus a '*** 30/03/2018 11:11 PM ***' line; the predicted date="2018-08-09" is marked date_correct=false, meaning the pipeline latched onto a different date-shaped token on the receipt rather than the DATE-labelled line, so label-binding is not firing.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: Did not restrict date candidates to lines whose canonicalized label matches DATE/INVOICE DATE (with OCR variants) and does not match a print/closed/promo/loyalty qualifier; also did not emit the chosen date in ISO under the declared locale.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Collect date-shaped tokens, pre-filter to lines whose owning label matches DATE/INVOICE DATE (allowing OCR variants) and is not qualified by PRINT/CLOSED/CLOSING/FRN/LOYALTY/PROMO, parse under the task's declared locale (DD/MM/YYYY first for MY receipts), and emit YYYY-MM-DD.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies to receipts whose task prompt declares an ISO date output and a date locale; label-binding is scoped to tokens adjacent to a DATE-family label and does not alter non-receipt date parsing.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Documents without an explicit DATE label (free-form text), tasks where print/close timestamps are the required field, or receipts with a different declared locale.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → receipt_date_label_binding_and_locale

overlay.composition_issue: The current skill already contains the full receipt-extraction overlay (keyword-priority disambiguation, two-decimal invariant, consensus, label-bound dates, null-vs-empty-string contract, delivery self-check). The remaining four observable failures are not caused by missing anchors but by weak execution/composition of those existing anchors: null writeback silently emitted "" on 078; corroborated-support reconciliation did not override a last-in-tier OCR-corrupted candidate on 074; the exclusion-aware filter does not screen the Excluding/Excl. qualifier on 077; and date label-binding did not filter the PRN ON / print-timestamp sibling on 034. Any patch should strengthen cross-references and worked micro-examples around these anchors rather than add new sections; preserve all current anchor names, tier semantics, scope boundaries, and negative boundaries so unrelated skills (openai-vision, pdf, video-frame-extraction, generic xlsx guidance) are not infected with receipt-specific heuristics.
preservation_constraints: Keep the receipt overlay scoped to tasks that declare keyword/exclusion/null conventions; do not promote it into generic OCR behavior.
Preserve the existing keyword tier order and exclusion keyword list exactly as given by the task prompt; do not reorder, drop, or silently extend tiers.
Keep the monetary_two_decimal_invariant and OCR amount normalization constraints unchanged; do not loosen to one-decimal or free-text substitutions.
Keep null_vs_empty_string_contract scoped to tasks whose contract distinguishes null from empty string; do not generalize to tasks using "" or placeholder sentinels.
Keep xlsx_delivery_contract_self_check scoped to data-only workbooks; do not run recalc.py on no-formula outputs or impose null checks on financial-model tasks.
Do not import receipt-specific currency tokens, locale orderings, or keyword tiers into openai-vision, pdf, or video-frame-extraction skills.

package_assessment.rationale: All four observable field failures (078 amount null-writeback, 074 total consensus, 077 total exclusion filter, 034 date label-binding) map cleanly onto existing anchors in the current image-ocr and xlsx SKILL.md receipt overlays and are controllable through stronger composition of those anchors. The source run terminated by max_iterations (65) with zero skill invocations despite preloaded skill context, indicating the receipt overlay was present but not reliably executed; this is a skill-controllable composition weakness rather than an infrastructure or verifier-only issue, and does not require new anchors.
